content.short: CUBE3.AI is a web3 safety platform using proprietary AI to prevent real-time fraud and crypto crime.
content.description: CUBE3.AI is a web3 safety and security platform focused on real-time fraud and crypto-crime prevention. It leverages proprietary artificial intelligence models to protect digital assets and transactions from fraud, cyber exploits, hacks, scams, and compliance risks, helping businesses increase revenue, reduce chargebacks, and minimize losses. This technology not only responds to incidents but also anticipates and prevents them before they occur, safeguarding crypto transactions across the supported networks.
